title: Vampire store
content: This is one of my very first memorable dreams that I've had more than 3 times and it happened all the same way everytime to a tea. So it starts out as me falling asleep I can see and hear waves of water than I spawn in. We arrive in a old beat up grey metal van. To a convenience store to pick up snacks. In this dream I'm always a little kid under the age of 10 so I'm not very strong physically. We enter and immediately we realize it's not a convenience store and I can see multiple ottomans all around the building that are red velvet cusions with black leather around the edges. On each ottoman there is a very attractive vampire women sitting on them waiting to seduce and trap unsuspecting visitors. Me and my aunt, sister, brother, grandma ,mom etc all shoved under an ottoman terrified and hiding but I didn't fit. Since we all didnt fit I got pushed out from under and the vampire women picked me up and looked at me as if she wanted to do more than just suck my blood. She wanted my entire being and soul. I let my family escape as I became the distraction. Early on I knew my strength. I easily got away from that awful creature and jumped with superhuman strength on top of the van as my grandma sped away down the mountain. And as the wind smacked against me I yelled "please slow down so I dont fall off!" The roof was frosted and i remember feeling at ease as we drove off. I always wake up before we get far enough away. But everytime i have that dream i feel like it's a test if i would sacrifice myself for the ones I love. Everytime i choose my family's life over mine.
